Name: CP - SH's Pepper Dragons - Dinosaur Replacer
Author: plurffle
Description:
[b][size=5]This mod [u]does not[/u] add any new content to the game.[/size][/b]


Just a random mod idea I thought up around... A few hours ago. That's pretty much it. It's just a small visual replacement. >w<

This mod replaces the dinosaur sprites and pepper rex sprites with dragon/wyvern sprites, as well as editing the internal names/description of the dinosaur egg and dinosaur mayonnaise (all are configurable!). Aside from a big shape change, I still wanted to maintain the same features of the original Pepper Rex and dinosaur (keeping the colors and spikes). The dinosaur replacement version also has two configurable options: with eyeshine and no eyeshine.

I [i]may[/i] include these sprites in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33611]SH's Wild Critter Tweaks[/url] eventually (the pepper rex replacement to be specific). I just decided to make a separate download here in case a user doesn't want to use my Wild Critter Tweaks mod [i]while [/i]wanting to use [i]these[/i] replacements specifically.



I have a Ko-fi btw! If you like my works, then feel free to [url=https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle]buy me a coffee[/url]﻿~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
